assumptions.choice: Evaluate 'record over the last N bars' against the sequence lengths recorded during the preceding N bars (excluding the current bar).
assumptions.reason: Comparing current sequence length to previous bars' sequence lengths determines whether a new record high sequence length has been achieved.

assumptions.choice: Set default lookback parameter period_n to 100.
assumptions.reason: The specification explicitly mentions N=100 as the example default window size.
